body: I managed to get a start on this review today... still more to go, but hopefully this helps.
Not an authoritative review; but some questions that popped up while quickly reading the PR.

Lots of editorial issues; as always, if you can be sure to do an extra sweep to make sure you catch multiple instances, that saves a lot of time.

On normative issues, I think these are the biggest outstanding ones:

- show/hide naming (under discussion in Open UI I guess, not sure how that's going)
- Element vs. HTMLElement; i.e., behavior for unknown, SVG, and MathML elements
- Some confusion about spec text for some animation pausing stuff
- Light dismiss spec intercepting capture events on Document is quite unusual; @annevk's help there would be appreciated steering us in the right direction
This is a very big PR and I can't review it all in one go. Submitting some comments for things I found in my first sitting.
Another round of review. I'm starting to feel like I've read most of the spec text now, but still not 100%. (Not doing it top to bottom makes it harder to say.)

Overall I think the reduced scope and @domenic's excellent feedback have helped this feature a lot. E.g., no longer needing the DOM PR and postponing `defaultopen` is great news. I found a number of nits and I wonder if we can have something better around animations as it seems really awkward that we'd need an explicit tie-in for that.
Alright, I've reviewed this starting from the bottom now, so in total I've reviewed roughly the first and last third of this line-by-line now. Will get back to the middle bit next week.
In this round I've focused on code reached via `element.showPopover()`. A non-normative description of what the "open ancestral popover" does at a higher level would be very helpful.

OK, with "nearest open ancestral popover" reviewed I think I've looked at everything in this PR carefully at least once. I've almost certainly overlooked some things, but I think there are diminishing returns to me spending more time on this.

If I have previous comments that aren't resolved please consider those still relevant, and of course other reviewers may have feedback still.

Why does "popover target attribute activation behavior" check for disabled and not "popover target element"?

(These are mainly nits and some small gotchas. Looks good by-and-large, but it's also getting hard to review given the number of resolved comment threads and such.)

I still found quite a few issues. I'm not entirely sure about the past issues as the force-pushing makes it hard to find those. Perhaps only force push every now and then and mainly stick to fixup commits?

I also noticed that the Elements index hasn't been updated. The `input` and `button` elements need to be modified.
